headline: For the Silver account, the official credit leaves out a 0.025% relationship bonus that this task's own document grants (and that task_093 applies), and the cent amount also depends on the rounding method.

issues.summary: Gold Silver expected APY 6.65% = 4.0 tier + 0.45 Bluest + 2.2 EcoCard, with no relationship bonus. The required doc silver_002 and FAQ silver_005 grant +0.025% for holding multiple Rho-Bank products, and this customer holds 13. task_093 applies the same bonus with just two products. A doc-following agent computes 6.675% and credits $222.92 instead of $220.84.
evidence: doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_002 (required): "If you maintain multiple Rho-Bank products, you may also qualify for a relationship bonus of 0.025% that stacks on top of your base Silver APY."
doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_005: "Do I get a bonus for having multiple Rho-Bank products? - Yes. Eligible customers receive a relationship APY bonus of 0.025% added to the base Silver APY."
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_044: "Missing Relationship Bonus: Customer maintains multiple Rho-Bank products but the relationship bonus was not applied."
task_093 gold[8].expected_apy = 4.275 (includes the 0.025 with two products)
replay: Silver credit 222.92 -> verified match False (accounts, bank_account_transaction_history differ)
issues.why_it_matters: Leaving the bonus out requires ignoring a required document and contradicts task_093. A competent agent includes it and fails. doc_savings_accounts_silver_plus_account_002 ("an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria") creates the same exposure for the Silver Plus credit (12.375 vs gold 12.00).
issues.suggested_fix: Add the 0.025% to the Silver (and, if intended, Silver Plus) expected APY and credit, or define relationship-bonus eligibility so that it excludes this customer, and keep task_093 consistent.

issues.summary: Even without the bonus, the Silver gap rounds differently depending on method. Gold uses round(expected interest) minus actual (554.17 - 333.33 = 220.84); the equally natural balance x APY difference / 12 gives 220.83.
evidence: replay: Silver credit 220.83 -> verified match False
issues.why_it_matters: The credit amount is persisted and hashed into the transaction id, so a one-cent difference fails the DB check. No document specifies the rounding method.
issues.suggested_fix: Pick balances whose gaps are exact to the cent (as in tasks 093-096), or state the rounding convention.

solution_check: Platinum 6.5 + Blue 0.8 + Diamond card 0.35 = 7.65%; actual 6.5%; $67.08 (matches). Diamond Elite 7.5 + Light Green 0.2 + Diamond card 0.5 = 8.2%; $70.00 (matches). Silver Plus tier 2 4.5 + Blue 0.35 + EcoCard 0.45 = 5.3%; $12.00 (matches unless the silver_plus relationship bonus is added). Silver: 4.0 + Bluest 0.45 + EcoCard 2.2 + relationship 0.025 = 6.675%, giving $222.92, which does not match gold's $220.84.
prior_note: The prior Major (omitted Silver relationship bonus, inconsistent with task_093) persists; I raise it to Blocker because the omission contradicts this task's own required doc, and I add a new rounding ambiguity on the same credit.
notes: submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294 calls add_to_db("interest_discrepancy_reports", ...), but TransactionalDB has no such table, so add_to_db returns False and the tool still prints success. The report persists nothing; only its tool name in agent_discoverable_tools (a write, always logged) is graded. Its expected_apy, actual_apy, and amount_difference arguments therefore never affect the DB result; only the apply_savings_account_credit_6831 amount does (it changes accounts.current_holdings and a transaction_id hashed from the amount). The savings docs say interest is "compounded daily" from a daily periodic rate, but every posted credit equals balance x APY / 12 exactly. Gold uses that monthly convention, and an agent that back-solves actual_apy from the posted credit adopts it naturally. A literal daily-compounding computation would give a slightly different credit. doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_009 lists Platinum +0.2%/Diamond +0.25% card bonuses not in silver_006; the max is still EcoCard 2.2%, so there is no impact. silver_002 still contains the "[[linked_checking_apy_bonus]]" placeholder.
